page.content:
Peking-opera fighter who wants to change Heihachi and save Jin.

How Ling Xiaoyu connects

  • Work: Tekken 3 — Tekken 3 introduced Ling Xiaoyu to the Iron Fist cast.
  • Character: Jin Kazama — Xiaoyu keeps trying to pull Jin out of the Mishima war.

What is Ling Xiaoyu?

Ling Xiaoyu is the pigtail fighter introduced in Tekken 3, a Mishima Polytechnical student who chases Jin and keeps trying to talk the Mishima men out of their war.

Key threads lead to Tekken 3 and Jin Kazama.
